variants.concept: Borrador Alquimia Cru. Minimalista, blanco + negro + dorado de marca.
variants.prompt: Vertical 9:16 Instagram Story, minimalist luxury brand poster for a Mexican artisanal brand. Clean warm white paper background (#FFFFFF fading to #F6F1E8 at the edges). Extremely uncluttered, generous negative space, everything centered on one vertical axis. Strictly three colors: warm white, near-black ink (#0E0E0E) and a single antique gold (#C0873B). No other colors, no gradients that call attention, no photographs, no people. Top: a large delicate thin-line gold emblem of an alchemical alembic still whose silhouette forms the letter A, with flared feet, a narrow horizontal opening at the top and a single teardrop centered inside it, drawn in fine even gold strokes. Below it an elegant light serif wordmark 'ALQUIMIA' in near-black with wide letter spacing, and under it 'CRU' in gold with very wide letter spacing, flanked left and right by thin gold horizontal rules. Middle: a large light serif headline 'Buscamos inversionistas.' with 'inversionistas' in gold italic. Below, two small figures side by side separated by a thin vertical rule: '$20,000' in gold serif with tiny grey uppercase label 'DESDE · MXN', and '30%' in gold serif with label 'RETORNO ANUAL'. Bottom: a solid gold rectangular button with white widely-spaced uppercase text 'DM PARA DETALLES'. All text in Spanish, perfectly spelled, crisp and sharp. Refined editorial print design, calm, premium and airy, flat vector-clean rendering, no watermark.

variants.concept: Corporativo / confianza. Azul petroleo profundo + dorado.
variants.prompt: Vertical 9:16 Instagram Story poster for a financial investment offer, premium corporate style. Deep navy blue gradient background (#0B2138 to #050E18) with a subtle gold grid and a soft rising gold line-chart glowing at the bottom. Clean modern layout with generous margins, all content inside the central safe area. Text in Spanish, perfectly spelled, crisp and legible: a small gold outlined pill at the top reading 'OPORTUNIDAD DE INVERSION'; a huge bold condensed uppercase headline 'BUSCAMOS INVERSIONISTAS' with 'INVERSIONISTAS' in gold; below, two dark glass cards with gold icons reading 'DESDE $20,000 MXN' and '30% DE RETORNO ANUAL'; at the bottom a solid gold rounded button with dark navy text reading 'MANDAME DM'. Elegant heavy sans-serif typography, high contrast, sharp vector-clean rendering, no photograph of people, no logos, no watermark, no lorem ipsum.

variants.concept: Brutalista / alto impacto. Negro + verde lima acido.
variants.prompt: Vertical 9:16 Instagram Story poster, bold brutalist streetwear-finance style. Pure black background with acid lime green (#C6FF00) accents and two tilted lime tape banners crossing the top and bottom edges, the top one repeating 'OPORTUNIDAD DE INVERSION' and the bottom one repeating 'CUPO LIMITADO' in black condensed uppercase. Center: small lime label 'SE BUSCAN INVERSIONISTAS', then a massive white condensed uppercase headline 'TU DINERO NO DEBERIA DORMIR' with the word 'DORMIR' set in black on a lime highlight block. Below, two rounded stat boxes: one dark grey reading '$20K / INVERSION MINIMA MXN', one outlined in lime reading '30% / RETORNO ANUAL' with the number in lime. At the bottom a lime circle with a black arrow next to white condensed text 'DM PARA DETALLES'. Spanish text, perfectly spelled and legible, extreme contrast, poster graphic design, flat vector rendering, no people, no logos, no watermark.

variants.concept: Editorial premium. Crema + verde esmeralda + dorado.
variants.prompt: Vertical 9:16 Instagram Story poster, elegant editorial luxury style. Warm cream off-white background (#F4F0E8) with faint thin emerald and gold concentric circle outlines on the right side. Text in Spanish, perfectly spelled and legible: a small emerald uppercase label with a short rule reading 'OPORTUNIDAD DE INVERSION'; a large high-contrast serif headline 'Haz que tu dinero trabaje por ti.' with the word 'trabaje' in emerald italic; a short grey supporting paragraph; an emerald serif line reading 'Se buscan inversionistas.'; then a dark forest-green rounded panel with two rows in serif type, 'DESDE $20,000 MXN' and 'RETORNO 30% anual' with the figures in warm gold, each row with a small gold outlined pill tag; at the bottom a full-width emerald pill button with cream serif text 'Enviame un DM' and a gold circle send icon. Refined typography, airy composition, sophisticated print-magazine feel, no people, no logos, no watermark.
